description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements API endpoints for managing leave requests, including retrieving leave details, listing leaves in a request, and updating leave statuses. The class extends a generic Endpoint and implements the CrudEndpoint interface, utilizing multiple traits to modularize functionality related to leave requests, user roles, validation, and date/time handling.

classes.name: LeaveAPI
classes.description: API class for managing leave requests within the OrangeHRM system, providing endpoints to list leaves, get detailed information, and update leave status.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of leaves related to a specific leave request, including detailed leave models and metadata such as employee information and leave dates.

methods.name: getOne

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing leave based on an action specified in the request, such as approve, reject, or cancel.
